_note: Pronunciation bank for top-300 fantasy players (one entry per name token). ipa = General American phones in names.json style (diphthongs/affricates split, r-colored schwa as "ə ɹ", no stress marks). Sourced entries cite Wikipedia IPA/respelling or an official NFL team game-day flip-card pronunciation guide; "common English name" entries use CMU Pronouncing Dictionary / standard readings. Tokens already curated in names.json (Adonai, Allgeier, Bijan, Burrow, Chase, Drake, Emmett, Higgins, Jackson, Jaxon, Joe, Johnson, Lamar, London, Michael, Mitchell, Penix, Smith-Njigba, Tee, Tyler) are intentionally not duplicated here. Built 2026-11-02.
